reviewNotes: Reviewed all 96 speech keys against all 20 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages26.json. Topic は corrected to わ only in reviewed contexts; directional へ becomes え, including extraction and transformation destinations. Object を becomes お. Lexical はっこう, はっこうこう, はたらき, はったつ and へんか preserved. Loanwords コク and ペースト transcribed こく and ぺーすと, retaining long-vowel marks. Process arrows rendered as comma pauses. Explicit readings such as おうはくしょく, あえごろも, つけどこ, えんすい, もろみ and ぎょしょう preserved. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
